prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Practice Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn how to summon, hide, and interact with your new companion on your screen.", "Shortcut: Press Alt+Pet to open quick desktop controls menu."]
2: ["Choose Your Ultimate Desktop Companion", "Select a personality type and visual style that fits your daily workflow.", "Select Companion"]
3: ["Verify Desktop Screen Compatibility", "Ensure your display layout is ready for rendering your 3D pet companion.", "Run Screen Test"]
4: ["Upload clear, well-lit photos facing forward to avoid 3D generation distortions."]
5: ["Your Desktop Pet Is Ready to Play!", "Finish onboarding now to claim your exclusive Founder Crown companion accessory.", "Unlocked: Founder Crown"]
6: ["Synthesizing Your 3D Companion", "Stage 1: Generating 3D Mesh -> Stage 2: Rendering Fur Textures -> Stage 3: Initializing Desktop AI."]
7: ["We'll send a system tray desktop chime when your pet is ready to spawn!"]
8: ["Secure Your Pet in the Cloud", "Signing in anchors your companion data safely to your cloud profile so you never lose your progress or customization.", "Use your primary account to preserve pet data across device restarts."]
9: ["Choose Your Onboarding Experience", "Select Instant Companion for quick setup, or Custom AI Generation to upload your own photos."]

verdicts.problem: Creates urgency and offers an exclusive gift accessory for completing onboarding immediately.
